title: Beyond Binary Classification: Detecting Fine-Grained Sexism in Social Media Videos
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on detecting fine-grained sexism in social media videos.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on sexism detection.
